children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may test a support at 4,930 ringgit per metric ton, a break below may trigger a fall into the 4,876-4,903 ringgit range.
The current fall might be driven by a wave c, the third wave of a presumed three-wave cycle from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit.
This wave is capable of travelling into a wide range of 4,788 ringgit to 4,876 ringgit. Immediate resistance is at 4,964 ringgit, a break above may lead to a gain into the 4,985-5,018 ringgit range.

On the daily chart, the uptrend looks steady within a rising channel, which indicates a target around 5,217 ringgit. However, the market has failed a few times to break the resistance zone of 4,990 ringgit to 5,032 ringgit.
The failures indicate the dissipation of the bullish momentum. The contract may retrace again toward the support at 4,897 ringgit.
A break below 4,866 ringgit would signal an extension of the correction from 5,031 ringgit, toward 4,814 ringgit.
